line: Motivation or discipline? Almost half who planned to exercise didn't do it.
An old fable book: good goals don't come by wishing. Get up!
Sparks are real: Murakami's idea came suddenly. Then he wrote every night.
Zig Ziglar: motivation doesn't last. Neither does a bath. Take both regularly.
No spark yet? Stravinsky: just as eating brings appetite, work brings inspiration.
Novelist Trollope trusted sticky wax on his chair more than inspiration.
Low energy? In 158 studies, one cardio workout went with more energy.
Rabbi Tarfon: you needn't finish the work, but you can't skip it.
credit: Rabbi Tarfon · Pirkei Avot 2:16, tr. Kulp

line: The Gita: each time the restless mind wanders off, bring it back.
Krishnamacharya: yoga's benefits come only with daily practice, same time, same place.
